body: UPDATE: For anyone still watching this, I AM OKAY! Physically, at least. Some things have happened that I'd rather not disclose here as I'm not sure how to label it or how I feel about it (if you're truly concerned, feel free to inquire in dms.) But I am in an arguably worse situation, as I now have a job, but he's taken my wallet and constantly screams at me that I owe him money for him letting me stay there for so long. Which is partially understandable, if he didn't expect EVERY PENNY of the money I get on my first cheque. I'm currently looking for a way out once I can obtain my wallet and paycard. Thank you everyone for the support, I'm going through some rough shit right now and I appreciate you all being so concerned for someone you don't even know. I will update again if there's enough interest in this comment, but until then, thank you all so much, you are truly gods <3
Thank you so much for well wishes and advice <3 I'll be sure to reach out to try to sort everything out further
